about_the_game:
A True Struggle for Survival

Slow-paced, atmosphere-driven gameplay combines exploration, looting, and vehicle upgrading mechanics. Players can scavenge resources from abandoned structures, interact with the environment, and gradually transform their vehicle into a lifeline that carries them toward freedom.

Interactive First-Person Experience

Key Features

  • Post-Apocalyptic Atmosphere: Collapsed cities, ruined structures, and irradiated wastelands.

  • Vehicle-Based Survival: Repair, upgrade, and customize your vehicle to increase your chances of survival.

  • Independent AI Third Arm: Your unusual companion can interact with the environment, assist in combat, and execute the tasks you command.

  • Dangerous Enemies: Battle against mutated creatures in a fight for survival.

  • Rich Loot System: Gather resources, craft equipment, and upgrade your vehicle.

  • Freedom Beyond the Walls: Can you escape the dark quarantine zone?

Who Is It For?

Perfect for players who enjoy survival, exploration, and post-apocalyptic settings. Ideal for those seeking atmospheric experiences, resource management, and the constant tension of staying alive under relentless threats.

Visual Style

The game blends modern graphics with a grim and striking post-apocalyptic aesthetic. Collapsed buildings, heavy fog effects, and the unsettling presence of radiation keep the player on edge at every moment.

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains sudden jumpscares, a dark and intense atmosphere, and a horror story inspired by real-life events. It may be disturbing to some players.
